verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API that lets you access, create and manipulate content with Bearer-token auth. It also documents an official MCP integration and Chat Connectors for agents such as Claude and Cursor, so an agent can read and write notes headlessly without using the GUI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that API/MCP writes work in practice, detail on which read/write operations the MCP server exposes, and a published OpenAPI spec (all probed spec paths returned 404).
